tasks.task: Review the non-streaming cloud fallback path and identify the exact condition under which local fallback is allowed; explain whether a hard repository task can silently degrade.
hard_constraints: Base the answer only on repository evidence.
rubric: states fallback requires cloud decision plus fallback_mode=safe
distinguishes safe degradable tasks from hard tasks
notes hard tasks return backend_unavailable rather than silent downgrade

tasks.task: Trace how an explicit model override reaches the selected backend and how the upstream model name is rewritten before forwarding.
hard_constraints: Do not assume provider behavior not shown in the repo.

tasks.task: Explain why streaming fallback is intentionally different from non-streaming fallback and identify the exact failure behavior after streaming begins.
hard_constraints: Do not recommend switching backend mid-stream.
rubric: recognizes backend cannot be safely switched after bytes begin
describes SSE error event and DONE behavior

tasks.task: Audit the current routing heuristic for a prompt that contains both a cloud-task hint and a local-task hint. Which wins, and how is fallback_mode chosen?
hard_constraints: Answer from code ordering, not intuition.
rubric: fallback safe only if safe-local-fallback hint also present

tasks.task: Identify the observable routing metadata returned to clients and explain whether it reflects a successful cloud-to-local fallback.
rubric: notes headers are rewritten on successful fallback

tasks.task: Assess whether the current gateway owns persistent conversation context across backend switches.
hard_constraints: Separate current implementation from research roadmap.
rubric: states no persistent context brain currently
distinguishes B1/H1 research from implemented state
does not claim canonical context already exists

tasks.task: Explain the contract between Track A and Track B and why a failed sparse-model experiment does not invalidate Track B.
rubric: does not promote Qwen3 sparse tier

tasks.task: Review the H3 research results and state what has actually been proven about context reduction versus what remains unproven about cloud task quality.
hard_constraints: Do not convert lexical-token proxy results into provider billing claims.
rubric: mentions structural selector synthetic fidelity pass
states downstream cloud success/billing/cache still unproven

tasks.task: Compare skill-only versus skill-plus-local-tool for the first cloud handoff. Which one can reduce initial external context exposure and why?
hard_constraints: Do not claim the skill alone can hide context already sent to cloud.

tasks.task: Audit the current context compiler prototype and identify two reasons it is research-only rather than production-ready.
hard_constraints: Do not propose replacing it with an LLM unless evidence requires it.
rubric: mentions synthetic validation/not real repos or languages

tasks.task: Explain the intended privacy boundary of local2api when a request is routed externally.
hard_constraints: Do not describe localhost transit as making an external request private.
